_README: Hand-maintained list of LONG-HORIZON compounder positions. This is a different bucket
from everything else in this repo: no price stops, no trailing exits, no 20-day horizon.
The Triggers exit rules (half at target, 21-EMA trail) are the best-validated part of the
system and they would take you out of a 10x at about 1.5x — so this bucket is kept
deliberately separate and money should not move between the two.
Add a position ONLY with a written thesis. If you cannot state what has to stay true, you
cannot tell later whether it broke — and 'thesis broke' is the only sell rule here.
ticker        NSE symbol (must match the screener sidecars for fundamentals to link up)
weightPct     % of the compounder bucket (not of net worth) — keep starters small and equal
thesis        one or two sentences: WHY this compounds for 5-10 years
mustStayTrue  the checks that define the thesis. When one fails for 2-3 quarters, review.
runway        what the company reinvests INTO — the factor most screens miss. A 40% ROCE
business with nowhere to deploy becomes a dividend stock, not a 10x.
notes         optional free text (quarterly observations, management commentary)
Target: 15-25 positions. Fewer than ~12 and you probably miss the one that matters; the
return of this kind of portfolio comes from 1-2 names, and you cannot know which upfront.
